summary: Forgotten Machines: Unforgettable Discoveries is a Digital Storytelling Museum that preserves and shares the stories, scientific discoveries, and historical importance of retired space machines. It brings together NASA mission records, images, timelines, and educational resources to help students and space enthusiasts learn from missions that are no longer active.
details:
Our project, Forgotten Machines: Unforgettable Discoveries, proposes a Digital Storytelling Museum dedicated to abandoned and retired space machines.

Space missions may end, and their machines may stop working, but their scientific discoveries and historical importance remain valuable.

Our website brings together educational stories, mission information, images, timelines, and authentic NASA resources. It includes sections on Moon missions, Mars missions, other forgotten missions, NASA Data & Discoveries, and About the Project.

We use trusted NASA resources such as the Planetary Data System (PDS), NSSDCA, and NASA/JPL mission archives to share reliable scientific information.

The website is currently under development. Our proposed future improvements include interactive mission timelines, maps, and organized scientific data resources.

The aim is to preserve the legacy of space exploration and make these discoveries accessible to students and future generations.

AI Tools Disclosure: ChatGPT was used to assist with brainstorming, research, writing, and editing. Gamma AI was used to assist in creating the presentation design. The project concept, final decisions, and submitted work were reviewed and prepared by the project lead.

Project Presentation Video:

In addition to the project website and presentation slides, I have also created a video presentation explaining the concept, objectives, and proposed solution of our project, "Forgotten Machines: Unforgettable Discoveries."

The video provides a brief overview of our idea and highlights how the Digital Storytelling Museum aims to preserve the stories and scientific discoveries of retired space missions.
